One click per line through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn with the Configurator (the default mode, configurate items), a player standing in the neighbor cell of the clicked side looking at the transmitter. case: transmitter/setup/side/click number/sneak. setup=alone (no neighbors), setup=busy (cable east, machine up facing north, chest north, same type west, and a stone south). result: InteractionResult of useItemOn. overlay: the action bar messages the player received. before and after: the transmitter state right after the click (before is the state before the click), settled: 4 ticks after. changed: the sides whose raw type changed in the click, with from and to.
